Canada:Northwest Territories.notes: Lieutenant-Governors of the North-West Territories, 1870-1905. The NWT was created as a separate government from Manitoba by 38 Vict. cap. 49 (1875), proclaimed 7 Oct 1876. The first three Lt-Govs (Archibald, Johnson, Morris) served simultaneously as Lt-Gov of Manitoba and the NWT. After 1 Sept 1905, when Saskatchewan and Alberta were carved out, the remaining NWT was governed by a Commissioner (not a Lt-Gov). The 1899 file lists dates with OCR errors: Mackintosh shown as 1891 (corrected to 1893 per 1896 and 1900 editions), Forget shown as 1891 (corrected to 1898 per 1900 edition), Archibald date in 1900 edition shows 1879 (OCR error for 1870, corrected per 1899 edition). Cameron (1898) died in office and was succeeded by Forget. Johnson's first name 'Goodschall' in 1899 edition vs 'Goodsall' in 1900 edition -- correct spelling is Godschall per historical records.
